flows.name: Hovering a quest stop on the world map shows that quest's blue area
steps: Install the PR's shipped files as the ShortestPathForever folder (compare: no differing files; extra media/icon-400.png) beside ForeverCore v1.10.0 and /reload
With a journey of quest stops in Redridge Mountains and no quest super-tracked, open the world map: the stops are drawn and no quest area shows
Hover stop 5 (Collect 0/10 Shadowhide Pendant, Solomon's Law): the game draws Solomon's Law's blue area around the stop, and no other
